source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #172 (Scout, Sea Hag, Seahorse, Shadow, Shambling Mound, Shield Guardian, Shrieker Fungus, Silver Dragon Wyrmling, Skeleton, Solar, Specter and Sphinx of Lore; PDF pages 286, 322–328 and 361) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action, bonus action, reaction and legendary action entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. The Shrieker Fungus prints no Actions section, so its action list is empty. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Multiattack. The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

effects.name: Melee attack
effects.text: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: Shortsword. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: Longbow. Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Amphibious. The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: Coven Magic. While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Vile Appearance
traits.text: Vile Appearance. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag’s true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag’s Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

actions.name: Death Glare

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: Engulf. Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound’s space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.

monsters.name: Shield Guardian
languages: Understands commands given in any language but can’t speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.text: Bound. The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: Regeneration. The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.text: Spell Storing. A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

actions.text: Multiattack. The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

effects.name: Melee attack
effects.text: The guardian makes two Fist attacks

actions.name: Fist

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.text: Protection. Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: Rend. Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath
actions.text: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.text: Paralyzing Breath. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

effects.name: Paralyzed

traits.name: Exalted Restoration

traits.name: Magic Resistance
